body:
Hello I have just created the team Nitwit Core. 
This is a team based off of the YouTube channel Nitwit Gaming (which I own)
This team will hold it's own events and tournaments and have videos on alot of Avicus Gameplay. You can be in the video if you are on the team. If you would like to join Please put your skype name below so I can contact you for Videos and Events Etc.
